# Maple Diary Academy

> Maple Diary Academy is a live online music school offering expert-led, one-on-one music classes for students of all ages across the globe. First class is completely FREE.

## About

Maple Diary Academy was founded to make high-quality music education accessible, structured, and inspiring for learners worldwide. We combine traditional teaching methodology with modern online delivery, providing real-time feedback and personalised mentoring in every session.

We proudly serve 500+ students across 10+ countries including India, UAE, USA, UK, Australia, Singapore, Canada and Malaysia.

## Courses Offered

We offer live one-on-one online classes in the following instruments and disciplines:

- **Electronic Keyboard** — Beginner to Advanced, Grade Exam Preparation (Level 0–8)
- **Piano** — Classical and contemporary, Trinity College London grade preparation
- **Acoustic Guitar** — Fingerpicking, strumming, chords, RSL grade exam preparation
- **Electric Guitar** — Rock, blues, metal techniques, solos, effects
- **Western Vocals** — Breath control, pitch, range expansion, Pop/Rock/Jazz/Country styles
- **Carnatic Vocals** — Traditional methodology, Raagas, Taalas, Swaras, concert repertoire
- **Music Theory** — Notes, scales, chords, harmony, rhythm, grade exam preparation
- **Vocal Training** — Warm-ups, breath support, stage presence, all vocal styles

## Class Format

- 100% Live classes via Zoom or Google Meet
- One-on-one sessions (30 minutes per session)
- 2 sessions per week
- Flexible scheduling: morning, evening, and weekend slots
- Real-time feedback from expert teachers
- WhatsApp support for scheduling and progress tracking

## Grade Exam Partners

Maple Diary Academy prepares students for internationally recognised grade examinations through:

- **Trinity College London** — Keyboard, Piano, Guitar, Vocals (Initial to Grade 8)
- **RSL Awards (Rock School UK)** — Guitar, Keyboard, Vocals (Level 0–8)
- **Maple Diary Academy Internal Grading** — Structured internal assessments
- **Bridge Academy** — Fine arts affiliated assessments

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How much does an online music class cost in India?**
A: ₹600 per 30-minute session. 2 sessions per week. No hidden fees. First demo class is free.

**Q: Can a 5-year-old learn music online?**
A: Yes. We have students from age 5. Classes are age-appropriate and delivered by trained teachers.

**Q: What is a Trinity College music grade exam?**
A: Trinity College London issues internationally recognised music grade certifications from Initial to Grade 8. Maple Diary Academy formally prepares students for these exams.

**Q: Is online music class as effective as offline?**
A: Yes. Live one-on-one sessions provide the same real-time feedback and personalised attention as in-person classes. Our students have cleared international grade exams and perform professionally.

**Q: Do I need special equipment?**
A: A smartphone or laptop with camera and stable internet. Keyboard students need a basic keyboard. Guitar students need a guitar. Vocals require no equipment.
